title: Decision band, your blank readout
summary: The kit's D1 close, made specific to this page: the promise that a readout is yours to keep and yours to publish, beside your own readout's page one, still blank (the constraint named first, its one sentence a dashed line not yet written, the rest in one line; written by day 10), then the red Request a System Audit and the quiet Talk to the team first, with one onward link to the field notes.
story: The page's one ask. The visitor has seen the format, then the rule that keeps real ones private; the close turns both into theirs: the same document, blank where their one sentence will go, written for their company by day 10, and theirs to keep or publish. It replaces “Start your own readout” and “Request the full dossier”.
